text: DiskScratch in libsufr/src/build/scratch.rs creates its temp file at the first flush, not in new(). A DNA build makes one Scratch per bucket, up to 32768, most of them empty, and a version that created the file in new() measured 15 to 18% slower on the 10 MiB normal, long-n and protein rows with CPU use down from 369% to 323%. Measured 2026-11-04 on the Buffer branch.
